title: React
focus: React from the ground up, by hand: JSX, components and props, state and events, lists and keys, forms, effects, custom hooks, context, reducers, performance and testing with Testing Library, up to frontend interview level.
ladder: Performance: memo, useMemo, useCallback, avoiding rerenders

Interview level at Amazon, Zillow or Capital One: widgets built from scratch like autocomplete with debounce and keyboard, a listings map filter, an infinite list, a transactions table with sort and pagination, accessible and tested
